name: Integer overflow leading to out-of-bounds array access
topic: Integer overflow leading to out-of-bounds array access
description: Integer overflow leading to out-of-bounds array access -- a easy-tier binary exploitation challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Integer overflow leading to out-of-bounds array access"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is a hex-encoded XOR cipher (4-byte repeating key). Brute-force or crib-drag with the known flag prefix.
